_doc: Thiên Bảo Trai's Effect engine records (world-depth Stage 6; ADR-0009). Input to tools/design/combat_sim/put_effects.py under source world-depth:thien_bao. Unpriced. Rule text from design/world/depth/sects/thien_bao.items.json.

Sold.rule: Seal of the Land's Riches: when Hammer Price spends 10 or more Metal stacks on a foe, the seal strikes the foe's ward as well: the foe loses 25 % of its maximum linh lực and you gain a stance ward of 25 % of your maximum health.
Sold.approx: the foe's ward loss is modelled as burn_qi of 25 % of its maximum linh lực (weakening its main drain ward); the gained ward is a stance ward of 25 % max health.

Grown, Not Made.rule: The Grown Red Pearl: cannot be stolen, sold or broken out of combat. Once a fight, a blow that would put you Down is taken by the pearl instead (leaving you at 15 % health); it cracks for the rest of the fight and loses its combat modifiers (ward_pct -10, L1 -10, Metal buff stack_dur -24). Skipped while Going Once, Going Twice spends the Seal's stance ward instead.
Grown, Not Made.approx: cannot-be-stolen/sold/broken is out-of-fight; losing the pearl's static modifiers (khi_huyet_pct 15, than_thuc_pct 8, stack_effect_pct 24 [kim, buff]) mid-fight is approximated by ward_pct -10, L1 -10 and Metal buff stack_dur -24.

Going Once, Going Twice.rule: Hammer, Pearl and Coin, full set: when Hammer Price spends 10 or more Metal stacks, you keep a third of them on the foe; Bought Fate pays 4 % of max health from the Seal's stance ward while it holds and may flip a second crit taken per fight by spending another 4 %; and while you still hold that stance ward at Down, a killing blow spends the stance ward instead of cracking the Pearl.
Going Once, Going Twice.approx: Effects rule 11 caps Down refusals at 1 per fight (`refusals: 1`), so while the Seal's stance ward holds at Down (for example against ticks, Soul hits or shield-bypassing strikes), the Pearl's save spends that ward instead of cracking rather than granting a second Down refusal in the same fight; spirit stones are not in the sim.

Fights With What He Made.rule: The Xích Kim Furnace, full set: when you block a hit, your Sword's next strike comes hot from the furnace: it deals 30 % more damage, ignores 95 resistance points (~20 % of a typical ward) and adds 2 Metal stacks (8 s).
Fights With What He Made.approx: ignores 20 % of the target's defence is modelled as pen 95 (resistance penetration in points, ~20 % of a Kết Đan foe's typical ~479 ward points), since engine `pierce` only pierces realm suppression.
